title: AI-Powered Biometric Validation
description: Complete solution (backend + frontend) for identity validation through facial recognition, with liveness detection and immutable traceability, integrated with RENAPER.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.intro: A government agency needed to validate people's identity in real time, comparing against RENAPER data, with a liveness check to prevent fraud and traceability that makes every validation auditable.
items: Real-time identity validation against RENAPER data
Liveness detection with motion capture to prevent impersonation
Full traceability of every validation (who, when, with what result)
Demanding precision for a government-scale system

phases.title: 1. Facial recognition with AWS Rekognition
phases.description: Implemented identity validation through facial recognition, integrating AWS Rekognition for biometric matching.

phases.title: 2. Node.js/NestJS backend integrated with RENAPER
phases.description: Built the RESTful API in Node.js/NestJS that consumes RENAPER services, overcoming government documentation gaps.

phases.title: 3. Immutable traceability with AWS QLDB
phases.description: Implemented immutable storage with AWS QLDB so every validation is recorded and auditable.

phases.title: 4. Scale in production
phases.description: The system runs in production processing 500+ daily verifications reliably.

subsections.title: Real-time identity validation
subsections.description: The person is validated against RENAPER via facial recognition, with a liveness check that rules out impersonation.

subsections.title: Immutable traceability
subsections.description: Every validation is recorded in an immutable ledger, making the process auditable end to end.

subsections.title: Precision validated in production
subsections.description: The system operates at real scale with verifiable metrics.

items.label: AI to production:
items.text: liveness detection with AWS Rekognition showed that taking AI to production requires integrating vision, backend and traceability, not just a model.

items.label: Agency integration:
items.text: working with RENAPER meant resolving incomplete documentation through direct requirements gathering and iterative testing.

items.label: Ledger as a guarantee:
items.text: immutable traceability (QLDB) is what made the system auditable and defensible before the agency.
